title: US Lottery Rules and Scores
description:
Two sourced tables about US lotteries: state-by-state lottery rules (minimum age, state tax on winnings, prize claim deadline, winner anonymity, online sales, start year, where proceeds go) with a source URL for each figure, and scores for 71 lotteries, lottery apps and sweepstakes on a published six-criterion rubric.

Every rules figure was read from an official page (state lottery, regulator, statute, revenue department, IRS). An empty cell means not yet verified. Coverage is incomplete because some official sites block automated access: claim deadlines are verified for 28 of 48 lottery states and state tax for 24 of 48 as of 3 November 2026.

Live version with maps: https://usalotteryreviews.com/data
